info.title: FieldOS API
info.description: Read a construction company's FieldOS sites and records, create and update tasks and issues, and get webhooks when anything changes. Every key belongs to one company and sees only that company's sites. The company owner makes keys in the FieldOS app: Settings, API keys. Guide: https://github.com/Vidyuthlabstechnologies/fieldos/blob/master/docs/OPEN_API.md

post.summary: A record changed or was deleted
post.description: POSTed to your URL. Check `FieldOS-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex>`: v1 is HMAC-SHA256 of `<t>.<raw body>` with your `whsec_` secret. Answer 2xx within 10 seconds. Failures are retried after 1, 5 and 30 minutes, then 2, 5, 10 and 24 hours (8 tries). A webhook failing for 3 days is switched off. Deliveries can arrive out of order; use `data.seq`.

Row.description: The server row as the phones sync it (snake_case columns). Always has `id`.

next.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; null on the last

id.description: Same on every retry: use it to drop repeats

object.description: The row as it was when queued; null when deleted
